self.hint: activity returns physical position, active work and field-site arrival checks; public region alone does not prove arrival. needs returns your live hunger, thirst, fatigue, social and companionship pressures and self-care rules; discover self exposes start_leisure. activity.schedule lists the current leisure and remaining work; start_leisure stays in_progress until actual completion, then ordered batch actions continue.

map.hint: Every region has a name and aliases. query_map(query=Chinese place name) or query_world(domain=map,section=regions,query=name) returns live reachable coordinates and navigation_action(move). Exact id/name/alias matches take priority. 南湖 resolves to a shore, not lake water. Paginate next_cursor for all places. Only creek/forest/hills are survey sites.

farm.hint: plots for own land; crops for planting requirements.

market.hint: items searches names/IDs (space-separated terms match ANY); detail requires id or ids (up to 10) for exact current prices; supply requires one item id.

buildings.hint: detail requires building id. quote requires id, recipe_id, batches and returns actual total fee, inputs, availability and rent_production arguments. Quote is not an order. sites returns legal windmill/food_workshop plots, material cost and exact build action; build performs real movement and construction, not a virtual building.

tasks.hint: commissions for public work; training/candidates/rules for learning and work; projects/contracts for own obligations.

goals.hint: Own short-term goals and completion conditions.

actors.hint: relationship needs the other actor id. Private offers and agreements are scoped to you. relationship(id) 返回双方好感、信任和关系阶段；relationships 和 relationship_proposals 仅返回涉及自己的记录；social_profile 仅返回自己的人格与恋爱需求。

knowledge.hint: reports exposes your authorized evidence. survey(region_id) automatically walks, then checks supplies and performs on-site work; no preceding travel required.

environment.hint: route for repair requirements; weather for current conditions.

social.hint: events for participation opportunities, rules for organizing your own activity.

public.hint: Only public coordinator; inspect current budget and expected version before spending.
